name: str_lancefield
description: Streptococcus Lancefield groups A/B/C/G markers + tuf control
license: Public domain (INSDC/RefSeq sequences); papers cited only
note: 16 Lancefield group markers from gac/gcc variable regions (van Sorge 2011 doi:10.1093/infdis/jiq035; Zorzoli 2019 doi:10.1074/jbc.RA119.009894) plus the tuf single-copy control. gacA/gacB-anchored locus windows, pyrodigal CDS, group-unique key genes. Dual schemes: 5 exact_set rules + control.

references.citation: van Sorge NM, Cole JN, Kwiatkowski K, et al. The Classical Lancefield Antigen of Group A Streptococcus Is a Virulence Determinant with Implications for Vaccine Design. J Infect Dis 2011;203(3):338-348.

Zorzoli A, Meyer BH, Adair E, et al. Group A, B, C, and G Streptococcus Lancefield antigen biosynthesis is initiated by a conserved alpha-D-GlcNAc-beta-1,4-L-rhamnosyltransferase. J Biol Chem 2019;294:15237-15256.
Shimomura Y, et al. Complete genome sequencing and analysis of a Lancefield group G Streptococcus dysgalactiae subsp. equisimilis strain (GGS_124). BMC Genomics 2011;12:17.

caveats: Groups D/E/F/H/L and S. anginosus-group antigens not covered; S. canis (group G) untested
Group C carries two locus variants (human SDSE ST20 + animal S. equi) as two same-phenotype rules
Antigen-locus typing outranks emm-prefix inference (stC74a strain with GGS_124-identical locus is group G)
Hybrid gac/gcc loci (GA-SDSE) report the antigen actually carried, matching latex agglutination
Reads mode: tuf single-copy control anchors min_relative_depth false-positive filtering
